errors.text: The proposed addition of unspecified amounts of Hf and Mo does not reconstruct the targeted 4.2 at.% Cr addition to as-cast HfMoTaTiZr.
The claim that adding dense refractory elements Hf and Mo will limit density is unsupported and potentially opposite to the expected compositional effect.

The proposed coherent-nanoprecipitate mechanism is not tied to the intervention and conflicts with the target mechanism of lattice-distortion hardening plus crack hindrance by a reticulated Laves-phase network.
No quantitative improvement relative to a compositionally and processing-matched baseline is predicted.

The cited evidence concerns different alloy systems and does not establish that Hf or Mo additions produce coherent nanoprecipitates, preserve room-temperature performance, or limit density in the proposed generic alloy.
